method: Conveyance values (storm drains, inlets, culverts and open channels) read by hand from every atlas manual with its own rules (state, regional, county, city, district and federal; 243 manuals with page text). Candidate sentences were found by text search of each manual's page text for each criterion; each was read and judged: is it this requirement, for public or permanent stormwater conveyance (not sanitary sewer, water main, underdrain, BMP, detention outlet or temporary construction work), stated as a requirement (ok) or as a recommendation or example (typical)? Where a manual gives several values by road class or pipe size, the general or smallest-system value is recorded. Statistics count one value per state (the median of that state's manuals).
